data.body: Patch set 2 (a25f1b77913) on Gerrit 3476. PS1 got LLM-Review +1 and Verified -1; CI failed only on test_reclaim_resign (main breakage, gloomful-genial-pronghorn) on all 3 Linux cells. PS2 addresses advisories: the authorship-key startup check no longer reuses the Ed25519-only op-cert validator (now: regular file, 0600 on POSIX, ssh-keygen -y loads it passphrase-free; any key type, no temp copy), bare pytest.raises got a match, runbook notes a blank bot-key slot stops MCP startup. Confirmed the bot key on identity 594c's keyring (fingerprint oGCqzgfDMpDX...) is ssh-ed25519. fetch-secrets.sh wording advisory not taken: editing it redeploys review-bot too. Will rebase once the main fix lands.
